title: CTGAIN
summary: A thesis project implementing missing-value imputation using a CTGAN architecture combined with a GAIN hint mechanism, built on modified in-tree copies of the CTGAN and RDT libraries. It forks and extends SDV's CTGAN and RDT source (data transformer, transformers, hyper_transformer) as the core of its imputation model.
evidence: README: 'branched from https://github.com/sdv-dev/CTGAN && https://github.com/sdv-dev/RDT'; ctgain/ctgan/data_transformer.py imports rdt.transformers.ClusterBasedNormalizer, OneHotEncoder
needs: Vendored ctgan/ and rdt_modified/ are directly used and modified (data_transformer.py imports rdt.transformers), so this is a genuine derivative rather than inert vendoring.
